## Checklist

Everything here is public, forever. Every commit is deliverable: it builds, passes lint, type check, tests, full coverage and the hygiene scan.

- [ ] Tests added, named after the acceptance criteria
- [ ] Golden corpus snapshot updated and justified below, or declared unchanged
- [ ] No coverage exclusion added
- [ ] No dependency added without a justification below
- [ ] Every label shown in the site goes through the i18n catalogue
- [ ] No proper noun, no internal context, no attribution trailer
- [ ] Documentation up to date; a check page exists for every added check
- [ ] Changeset present when a published package changes
